About
English television and film actor who is known for his portrayal of Pin on the original Netflix series Free Rein.
Before Fame
He made his professional acting debut in the 2016 horror production Heretiks.
Trivia
In 2017, he appeared as an extra in the DC Universe film Wonder Woman. He was cast as the character Kaz Brekker in the Netflix series Shadow and Bone.
Family Life
He is from England and grew up alongside two brothers. He has been in a relationship with actress Caroline Ford.
Associated With
He appeared as a solider in the film Wonder Woman which starred Gal Gadot.
